summary: Executors now take work by memory instead of fixed counts. Each workflow learns how much memory its runs use, and its settings can set it. A run that would exhaust an executor is stopped or given a worker with room, work no executor can hold fails at once, and Diagnostics shows runs waiting for capacity.

evidence: Claude drafted this summary on 2026-10-23 under Jack's authority to merge stage 6 once fully tested; Jack chose the admission rules in session on 2026-10-23. No customer action is required; removed capacity settings are ignored.
